name: ANA MARIA POSADA
heroSubtitle: From concept to launch, I bring **design and development** together through an end-to-end creative process.
heroBody: I design and build **digital products, brands, and web experiences** for entrepreneurs, startups, and growing businesses.
aboutSubtitle: A designer with a musician's soul.
aboutBody: I'm a Digital Designer based in Vancouver with over 7 years of experience creating digital products, brands, and websites from concept to launch. My background combines UX/UI, product design, visual design, branding, and front-end development, allowing me to work across the full digital design process.

I care about more than how something looks. I think about the people using it, how the experience works, and how the design will actually be built. My background in Journalism also brings a storytelling perspective to my work, helping me understand audiences and communicate ideas clearly.

I'm also exploring new ways of building with AI, combining tools like Claude Code and Figma Make with my design and front-end skills to prototype faster and turn ideas into functional digital experiences.
servicesSubtitle: From strategy and identity to a fully launched digital experience — I help you shape, design, and build your brand, website, or digital product from concept to launch.
contactBody: I'd love to hear your ideas! Let's chat about how we can work together to make your vision a reality.
funFactBody: You'll probably find me making music, writing songs, or playing piano and guitar — bringing ideas to life in a completely different way. 🎵
